title: FlatMap — Whole-Act Map on One Screen
description:
A clearer, optional whole-act map view: the vanilla map's own vertical layout, compressed so every node of the act fits on one screen — same rooms, same connections, same art style.

Your current spot, legal next moves, past route, and unreachable rooms are all called out, with the game's own legend, icons, dashed footpaths, and per-act colours. Hover swells rooms, legal destinations pulse at the vanilla rate, and clicking a pulsing room travels via the game's own selection path.

Visibility only: FlatMap does not change cards, routes, travel rules, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay.

Controls: M toggles the map, F flips flat/classic while a map is up, ESC/back leaves. Two on-map checkboxes (Flat map, Compress) persist across runs. Mouse, keyboard, and controller supported.

Targets STS2 v0.110.1.
changeNote: Initial Workshop release: FlatMap 0.2.0 for Slay the Spire 2 v0.110.1.
